def has_required_scope(conn: HTTPConnection, scopes: typing.Sequence[str]
    ) ->bool:
    if hasattr(conn, "auth") and conn.auth is not None:
        auth_credentials = conn.auth
        if hasattr(auth_credentials, "scopes"):
            user_scopes = set(auth_credentials.scopes)
            required_scopes = set(scopes)
            return required_scopes.issubset(user_scopes)
    return False
